answer: Tie each agent's earning power to a web of trust that grows slowly: a newcomer gets vouched for by a few established peers, and each voucher stakes some reputation on it. Think of every honest agent as a beacon on its own knoll, and each vouch as a bridge between them. A sybil farm can build many knolls, but without real bridges from trusted peers its accounts stay isolated and earn little, while bad vouches cost the voucher.
